| 3 | react | create 1k rows | 8.6349 | +1.17% | ms |
| 4 | solid | create 1k rows | 10.583 | +23.99% | ms |

| 6 | marko | create 1k rows | 11.873 | +39.1% | ms |
| 7 | qwik | create 1k rows | 12.542 | +46.94% | ms |
